name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-11-01, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
